Exclude files from a rule's selection

Source: R/rule.R
modules_excluding.Rd

modules_excluding() subtracts files from the selection a rule has so far: the files a rule applies to are the union of its inclusion selectors minus the union of its exclusion selectors. Use it for the boundary a positive constraint cannot yet state: "only the API layer may call httr" cannot be listed out loud, but "every file except the API layer must not call httr" says the same thing as a negative constraint over a selection that keeps R/api_*.R out.

Usage

modules_excluding(rule, pattern, ...)

Arguments

rule

An arch_rule from rule() that already has a selector.

pattern

A single glob pattern naming the modules the rule must not cover, matched against file paths relative to the project root.

...

Not used. Present so a misspelled argument errors here rather than surfacing later as a confusing check result.

Value

The rule, with the exclusion attached.

Details

The pattern is a single glob, translated like modules_matching() does, and matched against paths relative to the project root. Call it after at least one inclusion selector, and more than once to exempt several patterns: the exclusions combine, they never narrow each other.

An exclusion that removes every selected file fails the check rather than letting the rule pass vacuously; the EMPTY SELECTION message names both the inclusion and the exclusion patterns (see arch_check()).

See also

modules_matching() to add files to the selection.

Examples

rule("only the API layer talks HTTP") |>
  modules_matching("R/*.R") |>
  modules_excluding("R/api_*.R") |>
  must_not_call(packages = "httr")
#> <arch_rule> only the API layer talks HTTP
#>   selects: R/*.R (glob)
#>   excludes: R/api_*.R (glob)
#>   must not call packages: httr

rule("everything but the sync job stays local") |>
  modules_matching("R/*.R") |>
  modules_excluding("R/sync_*.R") |>
  must_not_depend_on(modules = "R/infra_*.R")
#> <arch_rule> everything but the sync job stays local
#>   selects: R/*.R (glob)
#>   excludes: R/sync_*.R (glob)
#>   must not depend on modules: R/infra_*.R
